ov: Several species of wild goat whose males carry large curved horns, ridged across the front. They live on steep mountain slopes in Europe, Asia and North and East Africa. Their horns appear at birth and keep growing for life.

why.et: Often hunted for its meat, with other parts used in medicine.

rg: Mountains of Europe, Asia, North Africa and East Africa.
df: Mostly grass, plus herbs, dwarf shrubs and conifer shoots (Alpine ibex).
fx: By the 19th century fewer than 100 Alpine ibexes survived, all in Italy’s Gran Paradiso park.
Male Alpine ibexes live about 16 years and females about 20.
